validation.counts: Exact whole-number digits from 1 through 1000000000000; no fractional or scientific count syntax. Leading zeros and surrounding whitespace are accepted within the bounded input length.
validation.physicalSeconds: Blank means no physical-time request; otherwise finite seconds above 0 and at most 1e12. Shortest round-trippable decimal formatting preserves the stored double.
validation.checkpoints: Request scheduled checkpoints controls the saved request. Off retains the editable interval; the interval is validated in both states.

drafts.revert: Revert edits adopts current applied values and clears the form conflict/error/guard.
drafts.conflict: Changes to owned settings preserve a dirty draft and disable Apply until Revert. Unrelated case edits do not conflict; clean fields synchronize after case Undo/Redo or another applied change.
drafts.availability: Apply is disabled for clean/conflicting state; Revert is available for dirty/invalid/conflicting state. Pending project or recording loads disable form actions.
drafts.guards: Save, replacement, duplication and new harness submission expose unresolved Setup and focus the form. Pending camera placement must resolve before redirect; resume and recorded playback retain separate behavior.
drafts.persistence: Applied settings participate in shared case Undo/Redo and exact save/reopen under unchanged project schema 17.

rules.name: The Independent Encodings Rule
rules.body: Vector color follows the selected scalar; vector direction and proportional length follow velocity. Selecting Pressure does not turn arrow length into pressure.

rules.name: The Single Recovery Rule
rules.body: Keep rejected drafts visible and the previous applied value active. Show the complete wrapped recovery message inside the popover without a duplicate default error popup.

rules.name: The Captured Key Rule
rules.body: Show length, sampled maximum speed, arrow count, and frame identity from the geometry actually presented. Preserve that meaning in annotated export.

rules.name: The Aggregate Ownership Rule
rules.body: Prefix combined seed and trace counts with “All seed sets:” in a selected seed editor. Do not present those totals as selected-object counts.

rules.name: The Frozen Trace Meaning Rule
rules.body: Annotated export must identify instantaneous velocity streamlines, their derived interpolation when applicable, and captured work-limit exhaustion from the frozen snapshot identity and summary.

rules.name: The Single View Owner Rule
rules.body: Keep direction, projection, triangle display, Fit, expansion and camera settings together below the input hint; retain sidebar-only workspace navigation and the separate saved-camera manager.

rules.name: The Explicit Topology Rule
rules.body: Show exact supplied or verified-derived connectivity with its provenance; never substitute a fabricated lattice, partial mesh, or implicit point triangulation.

rules.name: The Single Solve Owner Rule
rules.body: Keep Setup, Physics, BCs and Display inside one right inspector; category changes must preserve the scientific document, frame, camera and render revision. The sidebar remains the sole persistent workspace navigator.

rules.name: The Draft Identity Rule
rules.body: Retain unfinished display-editor text only within its project, solver instance and selected scalar; discard cached forms when any of those identities changes.

rules.name: The Applied Case Rule
rules.body: Show the applied case independently of retained text, and require Apply before draft values can change the case. Preserve the recording, saved Solve camera and frozen run configurations.

rules.name: The Rendered Layers Rule
rules.body: Derive both the viewport badge and inspector layer text from the same renderable-draft predicate used by the painter; never claim that invalid or conflicting text has an outline.

rules.name: The Containment Evidence Rule
rules.body: Report source/aggregate geometry verification separately from whether each object fits inside the applied domain.

rules.name: The Available Recovery Rule
rules.body: When an object is removed, retain its unapplied text, state that no mesh is being previewed for it, and direct saving to the enabled Discard action. Never instruct the user to use disabled Apply/Revert controls.

rules.name: The Independent History Rule
rules.body: Keep each history's verified source, original solver time, units and normalization visible. An independent run never acquires the active field recording's time, physics or residuals.

rules.name: The Named Compact Trace Rule
rules.body: In the force preview, draw only the named preview series; keep its ID, unit, position/count and Linear/Log scale visible while preserving the full project selection.

rules.name: The Original Residual Rule
rules.body: Keep the original time, first-initial/last-final selection, source lines and shown/selected trace count explicit. A residual plot does not establish convergence or acquire another run’s time or normalization.

rules.name: The Observation Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep UTC application observation time, severity and source explicit. A log entry never acquires solver time, scientific-history meaning or an unrelated project/run identity.

rules.name: The Explicit Command Target Rule
rules.body: Keep replay and control-harness command names explicit, revalidate mode/state/capabilities at every send, and distinguish a sent job request from its observed acknowledgement.

rules.name: The Recorded Probe Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the selected scalar, original frame ordinal, source step/time, position and sampling status attached to every probe value. Rebuild explicitly after the project, recording, saved probe or frame range changes; never substitute missing values or publish a partial history.
